about.title: The story behind {shopName}
about.intro: We are a passionate team supporting independent boutiques, concept stores and professional resellers every day. Our mission: give you products that sell, with the service that goes with it.
about.historyBody: Since day one, we've been sourcing the best references and new arrivals for you. Our catalog has grown season after season, guided by feedback from our retail clients.
about.showroomBody: You are welcome in our showroom to see, touch and test before you order. New arrivals are featured every week.
about.teamBody: A dedicated team is here to advise you, prepare your orders and handle after-sales. We speak English, respond quickly and know every product.
about.newnessBody: Our team curates new pieces every week to help independent boutiques refresh their offer. You are notified by email and on the site's homepage.
about.deliveryBody: Orders are prepared within 24 to 48 business hours and shipped across France, overseas territories and Europe. Tracking is available from your pro space.
about.photosCaption: Real photos from our showroom — updated regularly.
about.ctaBody: Create your professional account in minutes and access wholesale pricing.
